dedupe_keys.name: israel active and planned cellular antenna sites with radiation permits ministry of environmental protection

description: Israel's Ministry of Environmental Protection licenses cellular transmitting sites under the non-ionising radiation law and publishes the permitted sites on the national open data portal. The active antennas dataset lists 8,515 transmitting sites of the mobile operators Cellcom, Pelephone and PHI (the shared network of Partner and HOT Mobile), each with the operator, site number, city, address, local authority and jurisdiction, coordinates in the Israeli Transverse Mercator grid, site type (for example ground mast or rooftop), dates of the construction and operation permits, the last periodic inspection, the radiation permit status, the maximum theoretical power density and the highest measured result as a percentage of the health threshold, the transmission technology, and links to the permit documents. A companion dataset lists sites under construction. Both were updated in September 2026. Coverage: Israel. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files and the CKAN datastore API on data.gov.il, free under the portal's open licence. Caveats: only sites that need a ministry permit are listed; micro sites and sites of other operators may be missing; coordinates are site centres. Simulation uses: a national mobile site layer for hazard exposure, power dependency and outage models, including shared-network dependencies between operators. Related records: the Ofcom Sitefinder base stations, the Dutch Antenneregister and the Flanders transmitting antennas record give comparable site registers.
